onChain.note: deployTxId is the SDK transaction identifier returned by submitTxAsync (and written to managed/deploy/local.json). The node/applied extrinsic hash of the same submission differs; both are recorded so the inclusion can be independently checked.
onChain.extrinsicHashMethod: BLAKE2b-256 of the SCALE-encoded extrinsic bytes (from archive_v1_body), matching the node's applied extrinsic hash.

knownIndexerLimitation: indexer-standalone 4.4.0-rc.2 fails to re-apply the deploy's dust spend ('dust spend proof failed to verify') after the node has included it. This is a public-image read-path defect (fixed only in a private GHCR build); it does not affect on-chain inclusion, only indexer-based reads. The deploy pipeline uses submitTxAsync, which is indexer-read-free.
